author: ItzAidan
body:
Hello.
Well this topic is talking about Nebula. Lets say if you are on Senex 1,2,3 each map has 2 monuments. Well the rushers, if one of them destroys both the monuments, they receive a "double caper" credit prize. I've thought of the credits being 50 or 30 so far. It would work for any map. Such as Dust Devils to Frostbite to Quintes. If Dust Devils has 1, then its a caper. Frostbite has 4. You have to cap 4 of the monuments. So at the end they would receive on the screen
Broke The Monument: Credit Number
Your Team Won: Credit Number
And Double Caper: Credit Number

What are your guys' opinions on this? I thought of this suggestion quick so...
Have fun with your opinions!
-Aidan
